# FigureGuard — evidence-based acceptance gates

**A good-looking image can be scientifically wrong. A rendered PPTX can be uneditable. A passing code test does not prove either issue is solved.** Treat failures, pending reviews and successful generated bytes separately.

## Stage-wise checks

| Gate | Required check | Evidence / status |
|---|---|---|
| Source integrity | FigureSpec valid; exact node-edge/evidence refs; source files and SHA256 | Deterministic validator PASS/FAIL; scientific semantics often PENDING |
| Creative draft | Actual image generated and visually inspected, not prompt-only; spelling/arrow direction/coverage | Human or vision review, visible findings, source-anchored corrections |
| Candidate comparison | Visually distinct candidates, scientific accuracy before aesthetics, crossing/occlusion audits | `compare` creates a *review prompt* only; host must perform visual review |
| Design lock | Explicit approved candidate, image-anchored written guidance, no unexplained conflicts | `reconstruction-package` receipt + reviewer/author notes; design approval distinct from scientific validation |
| Numeric plot | Real CSV, finite values, no silent imputation/aggregation, source hash, vector/rendered figure | Source receipt and plot artifact, no invented confidence intervals |
| Native reconstruction | Editability at object-level, correct text and connectors, independent irreducible raster art | Inspect actual PPTX/draw.io structure, not a screenshot alone |
| Publication render | Renderer imports **actual saved file**, no clipping/occlusion, legible at paper width; grayscale when relevant | Reopen/rendered image from same file + explicit renderer identification |
| Final delivery | Requested formats really exist and satisfy purpose, unresolved issues disclosed | PASS/FAIL/PENDING per dimension; do not assert full PASS if unreviewed |

## Repair priority

1. Incorrect scientific topology, labels or provenance (may require revising the content contract).
2. Missing or wrong connections / clipping / overlap / unreadable text at final width.
3. Inconsistent grouping, visual hierarchy, line routing, color and details.

Correct *only the affected region* first, maintaining a selected design's readable global hierarchy. A local fix cannot justify global redesign. Do not use gratuitously complex SVG control points to mask a fundamentally bad layout; if a direction is unusable, redesign at the generative composition stage.

## Scripts and limits

```bash
python scripts/rfs.py audit --spec /PROJECT/F01.json --artifact /PROJECT/figures/F01/figure.svg
python scripts/rfs.py audit --spec /PROJECT/F01.json --artifact /PROJECT/figures/F01/figure.pptx
python scripts/rfs.py audit-package --package /PROJECT/F01/reconstruction
```

`audit` checks selected structural data, manifest hashes and obvious editability defects. It **cannot** interpret all scientific diagram arrows, independently verify measured experiments, or prove a PowerPoint/WPS renderer rendered correctly unless actual application evidence is provided. Keep these checks PENDING. `audit-package` verifies only the package contents/hashes, not native rendering or scientific truth.
